comment_regular:
Adjusts the single Oblivion billboard-leaf packed color for dominant-light shadow simulation.

Oblivion billboard-leaf shadow adjustment: compares normalized tree-center-to-leaf and tree-center-to-dominant-light directions, interpolates a scalar, scales the one packed leaf color, and reapplies dimming. Later 4.1 source performs this per corner; Oblivion does not.
